share extension.note: No existing tr string found; 'paylaşım eklentisi' follows iOS Turkish convention for share extensions. Note the core apps translate 'plugin' as 'uygulama eki' — that term is reserved for Mattermost plugins, not OS extensions.

bottom sheet.note: No existing tr string; 'alt sayfa' per Android/Material Turkish convention. Rarely user-visible.

long-press.note: Majority 'uzun basın'; one string uses 'uzun dokunun' — prefer 'uzun basın'.

tap.note: 'Tap to edit' = 'Düzenlemek için dokunun'. Do not use 'tıkla' for touch.

toast.note: No existing tr string; almost never user-visible. If it appears in UI text, 'kısa bildirim' is understandable; avoid the loanword 'toast'.

biometrics.note: Adjective form: 'biyometrik' ('biyometrik kimlik doğrulama' = biometric authentication).

passcode.note: iOS Turkish renders device passcode as 'şifre' (password = 'parola'). The single existing mobile string conflates it with 'parola'; prefer 'şifre' for the device code to match OS wording.

jailbroken.note: Repo keeps the OS terms: 'Jailbreak ya da root uygulanmış aygıtlar' = jailbroken or rooted devices. Note 'device' = 'aygıt' (not 'cihaz') per repo vocabulary.

deep link.note: No existing tr string; 'derin bağlantı' is the standard Android/iOS Turkish term.

skin tone.note: Webapp consistently uses 'deri rengi'; one mobile string uses 'cilt tonu' — prefer 'deri rengi'. 'default skin tone' = 'varsayılan deri rengi'.

server connection.note: 'Add a server' = 'Bir sunucu ekle'; 'Switch server' = 'Sunucu değiştir'.
